meta.subject: new CTA impl test bug fixed

en.summary: This commit contains real CTA-dispatch correctness fixes; the most reusable one is correcting the LDS base field width so dispatched workgroups do not truncate local-memory base addresses.
why_it_counts: The patch changes CTA scheduler and resource-table RTL, not only tests.
It corrects the LDS base width from an SGPR-derived width to an LDS-derived width, which is a real resource-address bug.
It also repairs a CU-group mapping edge case in resource_table_top when the configuration has only one group.
disqualifiers: The subject mentions tests and the same commit updates a large test file.
Some 32-based constant changes in the same patch look provisional and were refined later.
evidence: cta_scheduler.scala changes lds_base from UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_SGPR_MAX).W) to UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_LDS_MAX).W).
resource_table.scala turns NUM_CU_PER_GROUP into a parameter and guards the cu_id_group slice when NUM_CU == NUM_CU_PER_GROUP.
The same commit also hardcodes NUM_WF_SLOT and WG_ID_WIDTH, which lowers confidence but does not erase the concrete LDS width fix.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: CTA or workgroup dispatch metadata often carries base addresses for per-workgroup resources such as LDS or scratchpad memory. If the LDS base field is sized using an unrelated smaller resource limit, high address bits can be truncated. Once that happens, different workgroups can alias the same local-memory region or access the wrong offset entirely.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A workgroup receives an LDS or scratchpad base whose value needs more bits than the mis-sized dispatch field provides.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Define or cast the LDS base field using a narrower width derived from the wrong resource limit.
portability_notes: This maps to any scheduler, allocator, or launch packet that carries a scratchpad or LDS base address.
The bug can be injected either in the field declaration itself or by adding a narrowing cast at assignment time.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the dispatch structure that sends local-memory base information from the allocator or scheduler to the execution core.
Reduce the field width so it matches an unrelated smaller resource class, or otherwise truncate high bits on assignment.
Leave the allocator's internal base computation unchanged so the fault manifests specifically at the interface boundary.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CTA dispatch metadata width for lds_base
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit widens lds_base to use the LDS capacity rather than the SGPR capacity and also fixes a CU-group indexing edge case in resource_table_top.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In trait ctainfo_alloc_to_cu inside cta_scheduler.scala, lds_base changed from log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_SGPR_MAX).W to log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_LDS_MAX).W.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Dispatched workgroups can receive truncated LDS base addresses, causing overlapping local-memory allocation, wrong scratchpad accesses, or corrupted execution state.
evidence_for_injection: The width change is explicit and localized in the CTA dispatch bundle definition.
The affected field is consumed as execution-side resource metadata, so a width mistake directly changes DUT behavior.
resource_table_top was also adjusted for configuration correctness, showing the commit is about real CTA bring-up bugs rather than test-only edits.
notes: The LDS-width mutation is the cleanest portable reinjection from this mixed commit.
The hardcoded 32-based slot constants in the same patch make the commit less clean than a single-purpose width fix.

zh.summary: 该提交包含真实的 CTA 派发正确性修复；其中最适合复用的故障点是修正 LDS base 字段位宽，避免工作组派发时截断本地内存基址。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 CTA scheduler 和 resource-table RTL，而不只是测试。
它把 lds_base 从基于 SGPR 的位宽改成基于 LDS 的位宽，这是明确的资源地址位宽错误。
它还修复了 resource_table_top 在只有一个 CU group 配置时的分组索引边界情况。
disqualifiers: 提交标题提到了测试，而且同一提交还更新了较大的测试文件。
同一补丁中还有一些与 32 相关的常量改动，这些看起来更像临时性 bring-up，后续又被细化。
evidence: cta_scheduler.scala 把 lds_base 从 UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_SGPR_MAX).W) 改成了 UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_LDS_MAX).W)。
resource_table.scala 把 NUM_CU_PER_GROUP 改成参数，并在 NUM_CU == NUM_CU_PER_GROUP 时保护 cu_id_group 的切片。
同一提交还硬编码了 NUM_WF_SLOT 和 WG_ID_WIDTH，这降低了整体置信度，但不影响 LDS 位宽修复本身的真实性。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: CTA 或 workgroup 的派发元数据通常会携带 LDS/片上 scratchpad 等每工作组资源的基址。如果这个 LDS base 字段错误地按另一种更小资源的上限来定宽，高位就可能被截断。这样不同工作组会别名到同一片本地内存区域，或者访问到完全错误的偏移。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个工作组获得的 LDS 或 scratchpad 基址需要比错误字段位宽更多的比特位时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 LDS base 字段定义成更窄的宽度，或在赋值时按错误资源上限做窄化截断。
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何在 scheduler、allocator 或 launch packet 中传递 scratchpad/LDS 基址的设计。
可以在字段声明本身注入，也可以在赋值处增加窄化 cast，效果相同。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 allocator 或 scheduler 向执行核心发送本地内存基址的派发结构。
把这个字段位宽改成与另一种更小资源一致，或者在赋值时直接截断高位。
保持 allocator 内部的基址计算不变，使故障明确体现在接口边界的位宽截断。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CTA 派发元数据中的 lds_base 位宽
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 lds_base 的位宽从 SGPR 容量改为 LDS 容量，并同时修复了 resource_table_top 的 CU 分组索引边界情况。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 cta_scheduler.scala 的 trait ctainfo_alloc_to_cu 中，lds_base 从 log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_SGPR_MAX).W 改成了 log2Ceil(CONFIG.WG.NUM_LDS_MAX).W。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 工作组派发时可能拿到被截断的 LDS 基址，导致本地内存分配重叠、scratchpad 访问错误，或者执行状态损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 位宽修复在 CTA 派发 bundle 定义中是显式且局部的。
这个字段会作为执行侧资源元数据被消费，因此位宽错误会直接改变 DUT 行为。
resource_table_top 也在同一提交中做了配置正确性修复，说明该提交是在处理真实 CTA bring-up 缺陷，而不是纯测试修改。
notes: 从这个混合提交里，LDS 位宽错误是最干净、最可移植的回注点。
同一补丁里的 32 常量修改让这个提交不如单点位宽修复那样纯净。
